selection.name: SocratiCode
selection.role: C10 — Unranked finalist. Scoped MCP retrieval with compatible local embedding services and documented checkpoint recovery. Its default installation manages Qdrant and Ollama.

basis.shows: Project-scoped hybrid retrieval, configurable Ollama embeddings, Claude Code and Codex MCP integration, incremental refresh and interrupted-index checkpoint recovery. Default installation requires Node.js ≥18.17 and Docker.
Reports 61% less context, 84% fewer tool calls and 37× faster exploration versus grep on VS Code. This compares exploration workflows, not the other semantic-retrieval finalists.
September 28 release includes Git-refresh fixes and tests covering restart recovery; passing CI results were not verified.
Default-branch commit dated September 30, within 90 days.

selection.name: next-plaid
selection.role: C07 — Unranked finalist. ColGREP supplies scoped agent-facing code search; NextPlaid supplies local indexing and compatible embedding/REST infrastructure.

basis.shows: Tree-sitter chunks, project-scoped semantic search, changed-file updates, disk-backed indexes and built-in encoding. Documents Claude Code hooks, basic Codex integration and CPU/CUDA server installations.

Reports NDCG@10 of 0.859 with LateOn-Code and 0.846 with default LateOn-Code-edge, versus older Semble potion-code-16M at 0.853, across 1,251 queries, 63 repositories and 19 languages. This does not establish superiority over current Semble.
August 18 release provides Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 binaries with checksums.
Default-branch commit dated August 18, within 90 days.

selection.name: semble
selection.role: C04 — Unranked finalist for CPU retrieval through MCP/CLI. Supplies scoped, rebuildable indexes and local Model2Vec embeddings; exact fit to a separately served embedding service remains uncertain.
selection.install_command:
uv tool install semble
semble install

basis.shows: Scoped local retrieval combines potion-code-16M-v2 embeddings, BM25 and reranking. Documents Claude Code/Codex MCP installation, disk caching, automatic invalidation and Model2Vec-compatible model configuration.

Reports retrieval-quality, latency and token-efficiency evaluations across approximately 1,250 queries, 63 repositories and 19 languages. Detailed methodology and current matched comparisons were not fetched.
September 25 release adds MCP cache management and further agent integrations.
Default-branch commit dated September 30, within 90 days.

not_selected.reason: The packet supplies a model identifier and no repository; compatible serving, recoverable indexing and target-host retrieval results were not verified.

not_selected.name: huggingface-hub-native
not_selected.reason: Its verified scope is the Hugging Face Hub client and CLI; the finalists document the required code-question workflow more directly. [GitHub metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/huggingface/huggingface_hub).

not_selected.name: pgvector
not_selected.reason: Its verified scope is PostgreSQL vector similarity, making it a storage component with less direct capability fit than the integrated finalists. [GitHub metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/pgvector/pgvector).

not_selected.name: vLLM
not_selected.reason: Its verified repository scope is inference and serving; a complete scoped-code index and recovery workflow was not verified within budget. [GitHub metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/vllm-project/vllm).

not_selected.name: Haystack
not_selected.reason: An application-building framework; its verified description offers less direct clean-install fit than the finalists' documented code-search products. [GitHub metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/deepset-ai/haystack).

not_selected.name: LanceDB
not_selected.reason: Maintained embedded retrieval infrastructure, with less directly verified scoped-code and agent-install evidence than the finalists. [GitHub metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/lancedb/lancedb).

excluded.name: code-memory
excluded.fact: Latest default-branch commit is May 20, 2026, more than 90 days before October 1; the repository is unarchived. [Verified commit](https://github.com/kapillamba4/code-memory/commit/5a8db166ca11a90c093ba4a9a54d266cde756f54).

layers.deciding_comparison: The selection is an unranked shortlist, not a measured winner. Compare SocratiCode 1.16.0 with its documented Qdrant/Ollama stack, ColGREP 1.7.0 and Semble 0.6.1 on WSL2/Linux x86_64 with the RTX 4090 available. Freeze questions, expected source spans and repository revisions; measure span recall, answer correctness, cold/warm latency, indexing time, RAM/VRAM, scope isolation, changed/deleted-file correctness, interrupted indexing and restoration to a fresh instance. Repeat platform checks on macOS arm64. The packet's 30/35 versus 20/35 SocratiCode/ripgrep result supports only that sealed comparison.
evidence_gaps: Budget used: 6 web searches, 7 attempted page URLs and 30 GitHub API calls. No working-directory evidence was read beyond the explicitly supplied packet.

All 11 repository candidates were checked for archive status and latest default-branch commit. Latest releases were checked for the three finalists; issue responsiveness and release activity for the remaining repositories were not independently assessed.

No current matched evaluation compares all finalists on destination hardware. NextPlaid's comparison uses an older Semble configuration; published results do not establish current general superiority.
SocratiCode documents checkpoint recovery; Semble documents cache reconstruction; NextPlaid documents persisted indexes. Full backup/restore and end-to-end recovery correctness remain untested.
No passing CI outcomes were retrieved. SocratiCode's release names recovery tests, and its README links CI; these establish documented test activity rather than verified passing results.

ColGREP explicitly publishes Linux x86_64/macOS arm64 binaries. SocratiCode documents Linux CUDA/macOS Metal, and Semble documents CPU execution/macOS cache paths. Specific WSL2/RTX 4090 execution and Semble macOS arm64 execution remain unverified.
Semble's documented embedding backend runs in process. Compatibility with a separately served embedding API remains unverified.

Automatic approval review rejected ctx_fetch_and_index and execution-based context tools with: 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never.' Public README content was obtained through GitHub API calls instead; ctx_index and ctx_search worked for the pinned alternative READMEs.
